text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: —You want to ask me for special training?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Yes. It's a bit embarrassing to admit,
but I've gained some weight recently...

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
I want to undergo Ms. Gentile's strict training
and really shed some weight!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Very well.
In that case—no mercy.
I shall polish you with everything I have.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: "...Yes! I look forward to working with you!"

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
*pant, pant*...!
My legs... can't stop... yet...!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Oh, was my serve really that fast?
All you have to do is catch up and return it—simple, right?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Keep your head up. Fifty more to go...
If you drop even one, you start over from the beginning.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Yes! I'll continue to be in your care!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Tennis really is great for a full-body workout!
Let's do 50 more rallies... No, make it 80!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
—Fufu.
You truly are... someone I could never grow tired of watching.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Having endured Gentildonna's strict coaching,
Buena Vista successfully achieved her weight loss goals.
